gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-gujara: Snowburst One looks like a cut stencil sheet, with wide bridges between its letters and a tall lowercase. Noto Sans Gujarati follows with curved strokes that stop before turning inward, giving the loud heading a quieter partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjal: Contemporary and modern in feel, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has lowercase strokes as tall as a thick crayon mark, with terminals cut back to leave a big gap. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi sits under Snowburst One, whose stencil bridges and tall lowercase make the heading loud.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-gurmuk: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads clean and professional, its terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. And Snowburst One is the one that grabs attention, with stencil bridges and a bold, expressive voice that the plain sans never tries to match.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-hanuno: Neutral and contemporary, Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with lowercase and keeps its terminals open beneath Snowburst One's stencil bridges. Snowburst One makes the noise; the text stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Wide bridges between the letters give Snowburst One the look of a stencil sheet, with a tall lowercase to match. Noto Sans Hebrew then fills each line with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so a long stretch of it reads openly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-hk: A stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters is what defines Snowburst One, and its lowercase is built tall. Noto Sans HK is the plain sans beneath it, with brush ends lifted away early.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-imperi: Stencil cuts, bold and expressive, mark Snowburst One, which also has a tall lowercase and a wide opening like a sprung paper clip. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic stays approachable beneath it, with open pincer-like c ends.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian is clean and neutral, with big open eyes on every e and a and a deep middle band. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian sits below Snowburst One, whose stencil bridges and tall lowercase supply the loud, expressive side.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-jp: Expressive Snowburst One is all stencil bridges and tall lowercase, a heading that makes itself heard. Noto Sans JP does the quieter job, with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi is contemporary and neutral, with an open channel in the e and lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals. Its strongest quality is how calmly it stands against Snowburst One.
